payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy cost minimization using bitwise decomposition: ensure cost effectiveness (arr[i] = min(arr[i], 2*arr[i-1])), then iterate from most significant bit to least, accumulating cost while tracking minimum cost to cover remaining amount by possibly buying one extra current bottle.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a greedy strategy over bits with no priority queue, but among available subtypes greedy_priority_queue is the closest match from the greedy family and highest scoring.
